newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm increases preferred shr offer.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm increases preferred shr offer.

text.p: QUALCOMM Inc said Thursday it has raised its 5-3/4 percent trust convertible preferred securities offering to $550 million in gross proceeds from $450 million.

The securities are convertible into Qualcomm common shares at $72.6563 a share and will represent an undivided beneficial interest in QUALCOMM Financial Trust I, a Delaware business trust formed by QUALCOMM.
The company expects the offering to close on or about February 25.

It plans to use proceeds from the private placement for working and fixed capital requirements related to the expansion of its operations, financing of customers of its CDMA infrastructure equipment and investments in joint ventures or other companies and assets that will support growth of its businesses.
